类 ComplexAssertion

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.PolicyAssertion
      • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.ComplexAssertion

  • public abstract class ComplexAssertion
extends PolicyAssertion
